overall_summary: Most videos have low sample sizes (under 50 views), indicating low statistical confidence. However, content leaning towards 'self respect' with modern phone/digital boundaries (deleting chats, blue ticks, pinning, lists) slightly outperforms generic emotional topics, while deeply melancholic late-night or tea-drinking tropes underperformed.

winning_patterns.pattern: Digital boundary actions for Self Respect
winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Self Respect Status Story' (rwOUYo_hayQ - 41 views) and 'जब रिप्लाई का इंतज़ार खत्म हो जाए' (wFimeeP_aVc - 34 views) performed better than generic late-night tropes.
winning_patterns.action: Focus hooks on modern smartphone actions related to breaking attachment (e.g., removing from shortcut widgets, clearing search histories).

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'रात के ख्याल और अधूरा इंतजार' (uIbMpCjVutQ - 6 views) and 'ओवरथिंकिंग और अधूरी उम्मीद' (WhJ-VwRa3Rg - 8 views) received very low views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid passive descriptions of time or weather (e.g., 'रात के दो बजे', 'चाय ठंडी हो गई') and anchor hooks in active decision-making.
